name: Sumire
source:
The Big Sister

Sumire is organized, smart and a natural leader. When things went wrong for the Oni sisters, she was the one to take charge.

But underneath the calculating exterior lies a tender soul that wants nothing more than to help her family, and clear the name of Oni everywhere.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=studio.genius.onibishoujo]Google Play[/url]]
